choices: the pump power first exceeds the output power
spontaneous emission first exceeds stimulated emission
the round-trip optical gain equals the total round-trip loss
explanation: Threshold is defined by round-trip gain = round-trip loss (Γg_th = α_i + α_m), the point where a circulating field neither grows nor decays. Below threshold spontaneous emission dominates (LED-like); full inversion is not required, and comparing pump to output power is not the threshold criterion.
